rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something belonging to scholarly or higher-education contexts.

example.jyutping: ni1 pin1 leon6 man4 hok6 seot6 sing3 hou2 gou1

rows.note: Use this when “academic” means theoretical and lacking practical application.

example.english: This proposal is too academic and cannot be put into practice.
example.traditional: 呢個建議太理論化，落唔到地。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gin3 ji5 taai3 lei5 leon6 faa3 lok6 m4 dou3 dei6

rows.note: Use this for an academic or study track that leans toward humanities rather than technical or vocational subjects.

example.english: My son is on an academic track that leans toward the humanities.
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 zai2 duk6 syu1 pin1 man4 fo1

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on a bookish, formalistic style that follows established conventions.

example.english: His way of speaking is very academic and always follows bookish conventions.
example.traditional: 佢啲講法好學究式，成日跟足書本嗰套。
example.jyutping: keoi5 di1 gong2 faat3 hou2 hok6 gau3 sik1 seng4 jat6 gan1 zuk1 syu1 bun2 go2 tou3
